title: Committed use discounts and sustained use: where the real discount is

videos.script: The same machine can cost less. The question is what you give up. {{same}} Sustained use is automatic. Commitments trade flexibility for a discount, for one year or three. Spot trades the machine itself. {{kinds}} A commitment is paid whether anything runs or not. So the right amount is the usage that never goes away, and nothing above it. {{base}} You will work it out for the shop's batch fleet. Commit to the base, and every committed hour is used. Commit to the peak, and half of it sits idle at night. {{practice}} Then watch it for the whole term. Utilisation says you bought too much. Coverage says you bought too little. {{watch}}
